# One Dollar Computer — Curriculum agent brief
# https://onedollarcomputer.com/curriculum/

> Links with `?connect=` are **agent pairing URLs**, not lesson pages.

## If the user pasted an Agent link

1. Call MCP tool **curriculum_pair** with the full URL (or connect code).
2. Call **curriculum_list_lessons**, then **curriculum_get_lesson** / **curriculum_update_lesson**.
3. Store HTML in lesson `body.html[]` via the API — not in local `outputs/` files.

## Do NOT

- Fetch the connect URL as webpage content for a lesson
- Search the web and invent a standalone HTML file
- Create local files when the user asked to edit curriculum on the platform

## MCP server

Path: `/curriculum/mcp/bin.js` (stdio). Tools: curriculum_pair, curriculum_status, curriculum_list_lessons, curriculum_get_lesson, curriculum_update_lesson.

## HTTP API (no MCP)

Base: https://us-central1-odc-files.cloudfunctions.net/curriculumAgent
GET `/pair/status?code=…` → bearer token, then GET/PATCH `/lessons/:id`
